# Moonmarket — rules (version 1.4, final)

Welcome to the Moonmarket, where the stalls open only while the moon is up. Bring your cart and your wits.

## Components
- A board of 9 market stalls in a ring
- 36 goods cards: lanterns, spices, silk and tea (9 of each)
- 12 order cards, each asking for 3 goods and worth 2 to 5 points
- 4 carts (one per player) and 1 moon marker on a track of 8 spaces

## Setup
For 2 to 4 players. Each player puts their cart on any stall and draws 3 goods cards. Put one goods card face up on every stall. Lay 3 order cards face up beside the board. The moon marker starts on space 1.

## A turn
1. Move your cart one or two stalls around the ring.
2. Take the goods card on that stall, or swap one card from your hand with it. Refill an empty stall from the deck.
3. If your hand holds the 3 goods an order asks for, fill it: discard those goods, keep the order card for its points, and turn up a new order.

Your hand is secret. Filled orders stay face up in front of you.

## End of the game
After every player has had a turn, the moon moves one space. When it reaches space 8 the market closes and the game ends. The most points wins. A tie is a shared win.

## Notes
We've played this over 50 times at our game nights; this is the final version.
